pixel_pitch_um.evidence: search_description: The Samsung ISOCELL Vizion 931 is a 2.2 µm pixel pitch, stacked back-illuminated (BI) voltage domain global shutter (VDGS) near infrared (NIR) CMOS Image Sensor (CIS) with VGA resolution. It is the first Samsung VDGS CI.

optical_format.evidence: html_design_snippet: Table 3.0.1: CIS Die Critical Dimensions Metrics Camera module/CIS package dimensions 8.6 mm × 8.5 mm × 6.6 mm thick Device manufacturer, part number, downstream Samsung, ISOCELL Vizion 931 (S5K931), Galaxy XR Headset D.

optical_stack_height_um.evidence: table:Optical stack height (microlens/coating to Si): 2.7 µm

active_si_thickness_um.evidence: table:Back-illuminated active Si thickness: 7.3 um (active pixel), 7.2 um (periphery)
